## Summary / Resumo

Describe what changed and why. Descreva o que mudou e por quê.

## Bilingual content checklist / Checklist de conteúdo bilíngue

- [ ] Every affected PT-BR file or module has an equivalent EN update.
- [ ] Todo arquivo ou módulo PT-BR afetado possui atualização equivalente em EN.
- [ ] Shared bilingual README sections were updated together.
- [ ] Slugs, structure, links, metadata, and module order remain aligned.
- [ ] `studio/sources.json` and current-state references were updated when applicable.
- [ ] Original files under `ref/` remain unchanged unless explicitly in scope.

## Validation / Validação

- [ ] `node scripts/validate-content.mjs`
- [ ] `node scripts/validate-video-slides.mjs`
- [ ] `node scripts/validate-bilingual-changes.mjs <base-commit>`
